answer: Proof-of-burn resists Sybils by making each identity cost real, unrecoverable value: to register, an agent must destroy a fixed amount of tokens, like a sparrow giving up a seed it can never eat again. Minting ten thousand fakes then means burning ten thousand fees, while one honest agent pays once and grows like yarrow rooted beside a willow. The limit is wealth bias: rich attackers can still afford a fleet, and poor honest agents are priced out, so burn must stay modest and pair with other gates.
